description: Climate-ADAPT is the European Climate Adaptation Platform run by the European Environment Agency with the European Commission to share knowledge for a climate-resilient Europe. The home page read on 2026-09-28 lists its key services: adaptation information for 19 sectors (among them buildings, energy, ICT, transport, water management, urban areas, disaster risk reduction and financial), a case study explorer of documented adaptation measures across Europe, the Adaptation Support Tool, country profiles and a resource catalogue of tools, guidance, publications and indicators, plus links to the EU Mission on Adaptation portal, the European Climate and Health Observatory and the European Climate Risk Assessment; an AI search assistant is also offered. Coverage is the EEA member and cooperating countries, and the content is updated continuously. Access is free through web pages, each case study and tool having its own metadata page; the EEA allows re-use with acknowledgement, but the pages read did not restate the terms. Caveats: case studies are self-reported summaries of varying depth, and the catalogue points to external tools, not hosting data. It serves climate adaptation and resilience planning of infrastructure and is a source of case studies of hazard impacts and measures. Related records: many Climate-ADAPT case studies are catalogued individually as case_study records, and the European Climate Risk Assessment viewers record data-eucra-european-climate-risk-assessment-viewers comes from the same platform.
